description: issue #864: the two Sprites Kind-S statement-form heads in VALUE position, with the profile ACTIVE. The Sprites half of the same defect its Interaction & Events sibling `interaction-events/block-heads-not-values` pins: `spec/grammar.md:392` gives a keyword no derivation in a position the grammar does not cover. The source is the issue's own reproduction plus a call argument and an assignment right-hand side, with both names in one program so a partial fix cannot pass. `tell` is deliberately ABSENT: the C3 Sprites rows give it Kind **C** (a command with a callable form), not Kind **S**, so it is a legitimate `callable-name` and is pinned as such by the sibling fixture `tell-is-a-command-not-a-block-head` -- the two together key this rule to the C3 Kind column rather than to profile membership. Its byte-identical twin `statement-heads-ordinary-names-core-only` runs these exact bytes Core-only, where the same positions report `ol-unknown-command` instead. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
